entries.en: Narujj Boh is troubled by reports of frenzied nighttime rituals.
entries.fr: Narujj Boh semble avoir quelque chose à vous demander.
entries.ja: 灰の陣営のナルジ・ボーは、冒険者に頼みがあるようだ。
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Narujj Boh shares with you news of a new form of ritual taking place at the Zanr'ak altar. He asks that you search the area of the Zanr'ak encampment and altar for weapon caches, and seize the armaments scouts claim were enchanted with unholy flames.

entries.en: You have brought the enchanted weapons to the Ring of Ash. Narujj Boh seems amused at the time and effort his foes have invested, only to have their new toys taken away. Pleased by your deeds, the proud warrior suggests you take your rest until your next task is decided.
entries.fr: Narujj Boh vous a félicité, et espère que votre intervention aura mis un frein au rite étrange de vos ennemis. Continuez de venir en aide aux membres de la Ligue des cendres.
entries.ja: ナルジ・ボーにを渡した。冒険者が武器を奪ったことで、しばらくは敵のアマルジャ族も大人しくしているだろうと予想するナルジ・ボー。その間はゆっくり身体を休めるがいいと、冒険者の働きを労った。

entries.en: Every evening after the sun has sunk below the horizon, there has been frenzied activity at the chief Zanr'ak altar. Our scouts report some manner of ritual involving a growing number of well-crafted weapons.
entries.fr: Près de l'autel de Zanr'ak, des manœuvres étranges, la nuit nous avons remarqué. D'après nos éclaireurs, de l'armement, ils réunissent. D'étranges rites, ils semblent mener.
entries.ja:
奴らのアジト「ザンラク祭場」に、夜毎怪しい動きあり。
斥候からの報告によれば、何やら武具を集めて、
妖しげな儀式を執り行っているという。

妖しげな儀式を執り行っているという。

entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Considering the single-minded ambitions of our enemies, I assume they are attempting to imbue these armaments with the blessings of their god. We cannot allow such weapons to be brought against us.
entries.fr: Ces armes, ils renforcent en les brûlant au nom du Dieu des flammes infernales. Sa protection, ces lâches espèrent obtenir.
entries.ja:
おそらくは、武具を焔神の炎で焼き鍛え、
加護を得ようとしているのであろう。
かような安易な力は、断じて認めることはできん。

entries.en: Though I would sooner smash their tainted altar into a thousand pieces, I will settle for wresting from them the efforts of their misguided prayers. Honored ally, would you undertake this task, and seize these flame-sanctified weapons from the stores of our twisted kin?

entries.en: Once we have the blessed armaments in our possession, our mystics will unlock the secrets of their power and learn how to dispel the enchantments. This new threat will not long plague us.
entries.fr: Saboter leurs plans, nous pourrions une fois en possession de ces armes. Sur toi, je compte !

これぞまさしく一石二鳥！

entries.en: Yes, the heat of their searing enchantments is palpable even to a simple warrior such as me. Hah! The lengthy nighttime rituals of the Zahar'ak Amalj'aa come to naught! Rest now, warrior─you have done well.
entries.fr: Les objets que nous cherchions, ces  sont. Leur rite, ils ne pourront pas achever ! Merci.
